lines.text: What if I told you that failing is actually one of the best things that can happen to you?
Think about it.
Every time you fail, you learn something.
Every time you fall, you get another opportunity to stand back up.
But most people never realise this.
They fail once, and suddenly they think they're not good enough.
They try something difficult, struggle, and decide it's not for them.
But look at anyone who's achieved something extraordinary.
They've failed.
They've been rejected.
They've made mistakes.
The difference?
They didn't let failure become their identity.
They used it as a lesson.
Because failure doesn't mean you're losing.
It means you're trying something that challenges you.
So stop being afraid of getting things wrong.
Be afraid of never trying in the first place.
One day, the things you're struggling with today, could become the things you're most proud of overcoming.
Failure isn't the end of your story.
It's how the next version of you is built.
The next version.
